greeting: Egameni likaYise, neleNdodana, neleMoya oNgcwele. Kwangathi umusa nokuthula kukaNkulunkulu uBaba uSomandla kungaba nani nonke.
penitential:
Nkosi, usihawukele.
Kristu, usihawukele.
Nkosi, usihawukele.
psalm_response: Yeka ukuthi indawo yakho yokuhlala imnandi kanjani, Nkosi, Nkulunkulu onamandla!
homily:
Ake sicabange ngomzuzu othule kakhulu. Cabanga ngesithombe esisodwa: uBenjamin Vo, esemncane, ehlezi eceleni kukayise, beqaphe izindiza esikhumulweni sezindiza. U-Ben wayengumfana owayethanda ukubuka indlela izindiza ezisuka ngayo emhlabathini zikhuphukele esibhakabhakeni. Wayengabuki nje izindiza; wayebuka ubuhle bokuhamba, ubuhle bokufika endaweni entsha, ubuhle bokuba nendiza yakhe, leyo ayeyibiza ngokuthi 'con chim airlines'. Lowo mamatheko wakhe omnene, lowo gigo owayehamba nokukhanya kwamehlo akhe lapho ekhuluma ngamaphupho akhe, kwakuwukubonakaliswa komphefumulo owayephila ngokujula okungaphezu kweminyaka yakhe. Wayeyindoda encane eyayinomqondo ocijile, kodwa inhliziyo eyayithambile kakhulu, inhliziyo eyayikwazi ukuzidela ngaphandle kokungabaza.

Namuhla, uSaint Paul usitshela amazwi aqinile esifundweni sokuqala: 'Run so as to win.' UPaul usikhumbuza ukuthi impilo akuyona nje into esiyenza ngokungahleliwe. Uthi, 'I do not run aimlessly; I do not fight as if I were shadowboxing.' Lo mfanekiso womgijimi oqeqeshiwe usikhumbuza uBenjamin. Ben wayengumuntu owayezinikele. Wayengumfana owayezimisele ukuzama, ukuzikhandla, nokunikeza konke ayenakho, kungaba enkundleni ye-badminton noma ekufundeni ubuchwepheshe obuyinkimbinkimbi be-cloud infrastructure. Wayengagijimi ngokungahleliwe. Wayegijima ngenhloso, ngenhliziyo egcwele uthando, nangenkolelo yokuthi impilo iyisipho esifanele ukunakekelwa.

Kodwa kufanele sikhulume iqiniso namuhla. Sekuphele izinyanga ezimbili manje. Kusukela ngalelo langa lika-June 13, 2026, isikhathi sibonakala sishintshile. Izinyanga ezimbili zokubheka isihlalo esingenalutho. Izinyanga ezimbili zokuzwa ukuthula endlini lapho kwakufanele kube khona umsindo wokugigela kuka-Ben ngenkathi ekhuluma nge-'con chim airlines'. Usizi lufana nomthwalo osindayo. Alan no-Thao, ngiyazi ukuthi izinhliziyo zenu zizizwa zomile, njengomhlabathi odinga imvula. Niyazibuza ukuthi ingabe kukhona okungaphezulu enanikwenza. Niyazibuza ukuthi kungani lo mfana omuhle, owayephila ngothando, kumele ahambe. Ngicela nilalele kahle namuhla: Ukugula akulona iphutha lenu. UNkulunkulu akakaze akubeke icala. U-Benjamin akakubeki icala. Nenze konke okusemandleni enu ngothando olumsulwa. Susa lowo mthwalo wokuzisola enhliziyweni yakho, ngoba uNkulunkulu akakubheki ngokwahlulela, ubheka uthando olugcwele enhliziyweni yakho. UJesu ukhuluma eVangelini lanamuhla: 'Why do you notice the splinter in your brother's eye, but do not perceive the wooden beam in your own?' UJesu ukhulula, akabophi. Ukhulula imiphefumulo yethu ekuzisolenikeni okungafanele.

Bhekani, lapho uJesu ethi 'Remove the wooden beam from your eye first; then you will see clearly', usho ukuthi ukubona kwethu kumele kuqale ngokuthembela kuNkulunkulu. U-Benjamin manje usekulolu lwazi olujulile. Akasaboshwa yizibhedlela, akasaboshwa yimishini. Usekhululekile, njengendiza endiza phezulu ngaphandle kwemingcele. Ryan, mfowabo omncane, u-Ben uyamthanda. U-Ben uyambona njengoba ukhula. Ungalokothi uzizwe ungedwa, ngoba uthando lwenu luyisibopho esingasoze saphuka. U-Ben uyaziqhenya ngawe. Qhubeka uphila ngesibindi, ube yindoda efana naye—enomusa, enesibindi, nenhliziyo evulekile. Khumbula ukuthi nina nobabili nifana nezindiza ezimbili ezindiza ngokubambisana; umoya kaNkulunkulu ubanikeza amandla.

Kubo bonke abazali abathwele iziphambano ezifanayo, nabantwana abagulayo emhlabeni jikelele: UNkulunkulu uyanibona. Akabheki nje izinyembezi, kodwa ubheka ukholo lenu. U-Benjamin Đại Dương Vo—igama lakhe elisho 'Ulwandle Olukhulu'—useyisiphephelo sothando lukaNkulunkulu. U-Ben use-Banquet of Heaven, eceleni kuka-Saint Carlo Acutis, esikhulekela sonke. Njengoba u-Ben ayethanda ukusiza abanye, uthando lwakhe lusaqhubeka lugeza umhlaba ngaleyo 'Giếng Gioan Baotixita'—umthombo wamanzi ahlanzekile owakhiwe egameni lakhe, olethela ukuphila kwabanye abantu. Njengoba niphuma lapha namuhla, ngicela nenze into eyodwa encane. Lapho ubona izindiza zindiza, noma lapho ubona inyoni, yima kancane. Zitshele ukuthi: 'Nkosi, ngiyabonga ngempilo ka-Benjamin.' Khumbula ukuthi impilo yakhe yayiyisipho, futhi uthando lwakhe lusaqhubeka lugeza umhlaba njengolwandle olukhulu. Benjamin, lala ngokuthula. Uthando lwakho luyisibani esingasoze sacima. Amen.
standing_petitions: Sikhulekela uBenjamin Vo nabo bonke abashonile, ukuze baphumule ekukhanyeni kukaKristu.
Sikhulekela bonke abasenkathazweni, ukuze uNkulunkulu abaduduze abanike nethemba.
spiritual_communion: Jesu wami, ngiyakholelwa ukuthi ukhona kule Sakramente elingcwele. Ngiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwakho konke, futhi ngilangazelela ukukwamukela emphefumulweni wami. Njengoba manje ngingakwazi ukukwamukela ngokomzimba, woza okungenani ngokomoya enhliziyweni yami. Ngikwamukela njengokungathi usuvele ukhona, ngihlangane nawe ngokuphelele; ungangivumeli ukuba ngihlukane nawe nanini. Amen.
closing: Kwangathi uNkulunkulu onamandla angabusisa imindeni yenu futhi aninike ukuthula okudlula konke ukuqonda. Hambani ngokuthula.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Bafowethu nodadewethu: Uma ngishumayela iVangeli, akusona isizathu sokuziqhenya, ngokuba ngibophezelekile, maye kimina uma ngingalishumayeli! Uma ngikwenza ngokuzithandela, nginomvuzo, kodwa uma ngingakwenzi ngokuzithandela, ngiphathiswe ukuphatha. Pho, umvuzo wami uyini? Ukuthi lapho ngishumayela, nginikeza iVangeli mahhala, ukuze ngingasebenzisi ngokugcwele ilungelo lami eVangelini. Nakuba ngikhululekile kubo bonke, ngizenze isigqila sabo bonke ukuze ngizuze abaningi ngangokunokwenzeka. Ngibe yizinto zonke kubo bonke, ukuze ngisindise okungenani abathile. Konke lokhu ngikwenza ngenxa yeVangeli, ukuze nami ngibe nengxenye kulo. Anazi yini ukuthi abagijimi enkundleni bagijima bonke, kodwa oyedwa kuphela owinayo indondo? Gijimani ukuze niwine. Wonke umgijimi uziqeqesha ngezindlela zonke. Benza kanjalo ukuze bathole umqhele obolayo, kodwa thina owangaphakade. Ngakho-ke, angigijimi ngokungahleliwe; angilwi sengathi ngishaya umoya. Cha, ngiyawuqeqesha umzimba wami ngiwulawule, ukuze kungenzeki ukuthi ngemva kokushumayela kwabanye, mina uqobo ngilahlekelwe.

readings.label: Ihubo lokuphendula
readings.text: R. Yeka ukuthi indawo yakho yokuhlala imnandi kanjani, Nkosi, Nkulunkulu onamandla! Umphefumulo wami uyakulangazelela, uyafisa imizi yeNkosi. Inhliziyo yami nenyama yami kukhala kuNkulunkulu ophilayo. R. Yeka ukuthi indawo yakho yokuhlala imnandi kanjani, Nkosi, Nkulunkulu onamandla! Nenyoni iyazitholela ikhaya, nenkume isidleke lapho ibeka khona amaphuphu ayo—ama-altare akho, Nkosi yamabutho, Nkosi yami noNkulunkulu wami! R. Yeka ukuthi indawo yakho yokuhlala imnandi kanjani, Nkosi, Nkulunkulu onamandla! Babusisiwe abahlala endlini yakho! Ngalokhu bayakudumisa. Babusisiwe abantu onamandla abo! Izinhliziyo zabo zibheke ohambweni olungcwele. R. Yeka ukuthi indawo yakho yokuhlala imnandi kanjani, Nkosi, Nkulunkulu onamandla! Ngokuba iNkosi uNkulunkulu ilanga nesihlangu; iNkosi inika umusa nenkazimulo; ayigodli lutho oluhle kwabahamba ngobuqotho. R. Yeka ukuthi indawo yakho yokuhlala imnandi kanjani, Nkosi, Nkulunkulu onamandla!

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: UJesu watshela abafundi bakhe umfanekiso: 'Impumputhe ingahola impumputhe na? Ngeke yini zombili ziwele emgodini? Umfundi akadluli uthisha wakhe; kodwa lapho eqeqeshwe ngokugcwele, wonke umfundi uyoba njengothisha wakhe. Kungani ubheka ucezu olusesweni lomfowenu, kodwa ungasiboni isigodo esisesweni lakho? Ungasho kanjani kumfowenu, "Mfowethu, ake ngikukhiphe ucezu olusesweni lakho," kanti awusiboni isigodo esisesweni lakho? Mzenzisi! Khipha kuqala isigodo esisesweni lakho; khona-ke uyobona kahle ukukhipha ucezu olusesweni lomfowenu.'

day: Friday of the Twenty-third Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.

Ben ơi, ba nhớ con nhiều quá.

Mommy cũng vậy. Hơn hai tháng rồi mà ba má vẫn khóc mỗi ngày.

Con giúp ba má vượt qua nha, để lo cho em
Hey Ben,  nếu có thể hãy cho anh Minh gặp Ben trong giấc mơ nhé, dù chỉ là lời chào hay nụ cười như cách Ben vẫn hay tạo dáng để chụp hình. Nhớ và thương Ben nhiều lắm

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - need a miracle here. We miss you so much and we’re not sleeping much. Ryan wish you were here, especially this upcoming Saturday to play the new version of Project Flight with him.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Dear Ben, our uncle Thanh has passed away. Please watch over him and pray that his soul finds peace. His saint name is Phêrô. Lord, thank you for sending Chu Thanh into my life. I'll always be grateful for the time he spent tutoring me in math back in high school

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: can't stop thinking about you Ben... wishing i could go back into time and try to change things around... maybe spend more time with you and less working so much. Please pray for me and mom.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: I miss you Ben - haven't been able to sleep much these days. Please stop by to say hi whenever you're able to. Love you
